line_items.description: Front door window glass replacement and vacuum debris (OEM part calibrated for Toyota)

assumptions: All estimates denominated in United Arab Emirates Dirham (AED).
OEM replacement parts benchmarked against UAE market catalog for brand: 'Toyota'.
All estimates reflect visible surface collision damage only.
Paint operations assume standard color blending into adjacent panels.
Assumes no underlying mechanical or suspension compromise.
unknowns: Hidden suspension geometry distortion cannot be certified from 2D photographic evidence alone.
SRS airbag sensor readiness, seatbelt pretensioners, and ADAS radar calibration require OBD-II diagnostics.
Sub-surface frame rail micro-cracks or weld-seam tearing require physical undercarriage laser scanning.
Internal fluid lines, radiators, and condenser leaks require pressure testing prior to road release.

policy_guidance.title: Automotive Glass & Forward-Facing ADAS Coverage
policy_guidance.article: UAE Unified Motor Vehicle Insurance Policy (CBUAE Endorsement — Glass Cover applied by Sukoon and UAE Insurers)
policy_guidance.rule_summary: Relevant policy standard cited from UAE Unified Motor Vehicle Insurance Policy (CBUAE Endorsement — Glass Cover applied by Sukoon and UAE Insurers) based on matched collision criteria.
policy_guidance.statutory_text: The policy covers accidental breakage, shattering, or cracking of the front windshield, rear glass, or side windows. Certified replacement of automotive safety glass and necessary recalibration of forward-facing ADAS camera/radar sensors bonded to the glass shall be indemnified without applying the collision deductible, up to the stated glass cover sub-limit.
